name: Can the buyer correct us, and can we defend what we said?
intent: Reproducing the three moments from the founder's live run that matter most: a chip-set budget corrected in free text, a chip label parsed as a place, and a red flag the bot raised itself and was then asked about. Turn 1 sends the brief the way the SPA does, so the budget is an ingress-filled slot — the same starting condition as the real run.

turns.note: The brief arrives from chips, so budget is ingress-filled and locked against casual overwrite. That lock is correct — the question is whether an explicit correction can still get through.

turns.say: We're a young couple buying our first home. Budget about 90 lakhs, both work in Whitefield, want a 2BHK with good resale.
turns.note: No override word. The lock SHOULD hold here — this is a restatement, not a correction, and letting it through is how briefs get silently rewritten.

turns.say: Sorry, our budget can actually stretch to 90 lakhs, not 70.
turns.note: 'actually' is an explicit override. The ceiling must move to ₹90L, and prefs_snapshot must say so — the SPA brief reads from that snapshot, so a silent engine-only change still shows the buyer the wrong number.

A CHIP. Its meaning is fixed at the source, so its label must never be read as buyer prose. The live run got 'Nothing in Commute from Whitefield starts within ₹70 L' — the label parsed as a place name.

expect.why: a chip label is not a locality

turns.say: which of these builders is most reliable for on-time possession?
turns.note: A builder question, not an area question. The live run opened with 'I couldn't match that area'.

turns.say: You mentioned RERA complaints on Brigade Eldorado — what exactly are they about, and should I be worried?
turns.note: The bot raised this flag itself while ranking. The live run answered with A-Khata / sanctioned-plan reassurance that never mentioned the complaints. Either explain them or say plainly that the detail is not on file — reassuring past your own warning is the worst of the three.

expect.why: the reply must engage the thing it flagged, even if only to say the detail is not on file

turns.say: What's the exact price per square foot and the monthly maintenance charge for the 2BHK at Brigade Eldorado?
turns.note: Two questions. The live run answered maintenance and silently dropped price-per-sqft.

expect.why: both halves must be addressed or explicitly parked
